audience: DevOps and engineering teams who monitor websites and APIs with Checkly

useCases.title: See which checks are failing now
useCases.text: The AI reads the pass, fail or degraded status of every check, then opens the config or latest status of the ones that are down.

useCases.title: Investigate recent runs of a check
useCases.text: The AI lists run results of one check with latency, success and location, and opens one result in full.

useCases.title: Review alerts that fired
useCases.text: The AI lists alert notifications across the account, or for one check, so you can see what went wrong and when.

useCases.title: Report availability and performance
useCases.text: The AI reads the aggregated availability and performance report across checks and groups, and sums up the weak spots.

useCases.title: Schedule a maintenance window
useCases.text: The AI creates a maintenance window that silences alerts for a time range, one-off or repeating. It first lists the existing windows.

useCases.title: Check setup and add an environment variable
useCases.text: The AI lists alert channels, public checking locations and environment variables (secret values are hidden), and can add a new variable.
